summary: Verified all 4 footer fixes on Culinary Editorial template — social icons, ScrollToTop, company/support toasts, and newsletter subscribe flow. Backend newsletter endpoint and storefront settings tested via pytest (4/5 passed). UI verified across /menu, /menu/starters, /menu/mains, /discover.

minor.issue: Returns empty strings for social.instagram/twitter/facebook/pinterest because DB doc was previously saved with empty strings — _get_storefront() deep-merges DB over defaults so empty strings overwrite defaults. Frontend Footer mitigates this with SOCIAL_FALLBACKS so user-visible URLs are correct, but the API contract specified in the request expected populated URLs.

integration_issues.issue: Browser native HTML5 validation (input type='email') pre-empts the custom toast.error('Please enter a valid email'). User sees the browser's native validation tooltip instead of a sonner toast. Functionally correct (button stays 'Subscribe', input remains enabled), but the custom toast path for malformed emails is effectively dead code. Empty-string path likely still hits the custom toast since type=email allows empty submit without `required`.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In /app/backend/routes/storefront.py _get_storefront(), skip empty-string values when deep-merging DB into defaults, OR run a one-time DB reset on app_settings.storefront_settings.social so admin sees populated URLs in /api/storefront/settings. Currently user-facing footer works due to frontend SOCIAL_FALLBACKS.

OPTIONAL: Replace type='email' with type='text' (or add noValidate to <form>) if you want the custom sonner toast.error to appear for malformed emails. Current native-browser tooltip works fine UX-wise.
critical_code_review_comments: Footer.js subscribe() swallows fetch errors silently and still flips state to 'Subscribed' even when /api/newsletter/subscribe returns 4xx (e.g. 400 for invalid email). Since client-side regex already filters invalid emails this is unlikely to surface, but consider checking response.ok before flipping state.

ScrollToTop.js: useEffect depends on [pathname, search] only. If a user clicks a footer link to the same path they're already on, no scroll occurs (verified: clicking 'Full Menu' on /menu does not scroll). Could add a key or use a navigation-state listener to handle same-path clicks. Cross-route navigation works correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Footer fixes verified: (1) social icons have correct href/target/rel via SOCIAL_FALLBACKS, (2) ScrollToTop works for cross-route navigation, (3) company/support buttons trigger sonner toasts, (4) subscribe flow disables input+button and shows 'Subscribed ✓'. POST /api/newsletter/subscribe upserts into newsletter_subscribers. The only outstanding minor item is that DB-stored empty social URLs override defaults in /api/storefront/settings response — frontend masks this with fallbacks.

verified_evidence.social_icons: All 4 (instagram/twitter/facebook/pinterest) have correct href values (instagram.com/culinaryeditorial, x.com/culinaryedit, facebook.com/culinaryeditorial, pinterest.com/culinaryeditorial), target=_blank, rel='noopener noreferrer'
verified_evidence.scroll_to_top: Cross-route: /discover (scrollY=1183) → click footer-shop--menu → /menu scrollY=0. /menu (scrollY=3287) → click footer-shop--menu-mains → /menu/mains scrollY=0. /menu → footer-shop--menu-starters → /menu/starters scrollY=0
verified_evidence.company_toast: footer-company-our-story click → 'Our Story — coming soon' sonner toast appears
verified_evidence.support_toast: footer-support-help-centre click → 'Help Centre — coming soon' sonner toast appears
verified_evidence.subscribe_success: Filled valid email → button text='Subscribed ✓', input disabled=True, button disabled=True, success toast 'You're in. Check your inbox for the first edition.'
verified_evidence.subscribe_invalid: Filled 'bademail' → HTML5 native validation blocks submit, button stays 'Subscribe' enabled (custom sonner not shown because form onSubmit is blocked by browser)
verified_evidence.backend_newsletter: POST /api/newsletter/subscribe returns 200 {subscribed:true} for valid emails, 400 for invalid/empty, idempotent on repeat
